segments.oily: Reviewers who describe their skin as oily report no breakouts from the oil-based formula, though one says it leaves a residue that she follows with a second cleanse.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin consistently report the oil cleanses without stripping, tightening, or drying their skin further, several specifically noting it leaves their face soft and comfortable rather than tight.
segments.sensitive: Most reviewers with sensitive skin report the fragrance-free formula feels gentle with no irritation or stinging, though one reviewer says her sensitive skin broke out and she will not repurchase.

concerns.dehydration: Many reviewers say the oil leaves skin hydrated, soft, and never tight or stripped after rinsing, including several who specifically compare it favorably to cleansers that usually leave their skin feeling dry.
concerns.redness: Numerous reviewers say the oil does not irritate their skin or sting their eyes, even when used to remove waterproof eye makeup, with no reports of redness after use in the reviews supplied.
concerns.barrier: Two reviewers explicitly mention the skin barrier, saying the oil blend helps support it and cleanses without stripping it.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers with acne-prone or oily skin report no new breakouts, pore-clogging, or whiteheads even after regular use; two others, however, say the oil caused them to break out, and one will not repurchase because of it.
concerns.oiliness: Most reviewers say the oil rinses away completely without leaving a greasy residue, some describing skin as clean rather than matte; a smaller number, however, say it left their face feeling oily or greasy after rinsing, with one needing a second cleanser to remove the residue fully.
